cues.text: A glowing green clock face. Its hands close on twelve.
The clock fades into a full moon.
The moon becomes frames on a strip of film.
Aigis stands in a vast red hall.
A masked fighter lunges at Ken.
Ken blocks. Akihiko raises his fists.
Aigis leaps and kicks at Akihiko.
She vaults over him, upside down.
She lands and aims her finger guns.
Ken spins his spear and plants it.
The masked fighter waits, sword at her side.
Her mask is shaped like butterfly wings.
Fuuka, eyes closed, in a headset.
